subject: Coordinating demo windows across teams - ACME Systems (procurement + security)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmesystems.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coordinating a hands-on demo that works for Procurement + Security teams

Hi Lina — great to connect yesterday. As requested, we want to run a 60-minute technical + procurement-friendly demo for ACME (overview, integration questions, and a short security Q&A).

Attendees we recommend: AE (Marissa) to lead product narrative, SE (Karthik) for deep dive and integration, and a short slot for Security/Procurement to ask controls and contract questions.

To surface times that work across your east-coast office, EU security folks, and our APAC SE backup, I put together three rotating windows that give at least one hour overlap with each region. Can you please confirm which of these lanes would work for you and whether procurement/security require a separate invite?

Option A: 08:30–09:30 PT (11:30–12:30 ET / 17:30–18:30 CET) — best for ACME east-coast + Europe evening
Option B: 15:00–16:00 PT (18:00–19:00 ET / 00:00–01:00 CET next day) — awkward for EU but fine for US; we can rotate weekly
Option C: 23:00–00:00 PT (02:00–03:00 ET / 08:00–09:00 SGT) — best for APAC + late US overlap

I attached a draft mutual action plan and our short security questionnaire for your security team to scan before the call. If none of the lanes work, tell us the earliest/ latest acceptable start times and we’ll pivot.

Thanks — Marissa
--
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmesystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, ACME Procurement <procurement@acmesystems.com>, sec-requests@acmesystems.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating a hands-on demo that works for Procurement + Security teams

Hi Marissa — thanks for laying this out. Quick notes from our side:

- Procurement needs to be on the call, but prefers a single 30-minute block dedicated to commercial/contract questions — ideally at the end.
- Security asked us to include a short (15–20m) run-through of data flow and retention during the demo — they will review the questionnaire before then.
- Our EU security lead (Mark Liu) cannot do evenings; his availability windows are 09:00–12:00 CET.
- Desired outcome: proof of integration approach + high-level SSO/data retention answers so procurement can start internal approvals.

From the options you proposed, Option A is closest but it’s 17:30 CET which is late for Mark. If you can shift Option A earlier by one hour (07:30 PT / 10:30 ET / 16:30 CET), that would work for us. Alternatively, we can do 08:30 PT on Fridays where Mark can sometimes join.

We’ll also need the final invite to include a link to the security questionnaire and a copy of the MSA redlines timeline for review.

— Lina
Lina Gomez | Director, Cloud Engineering, ACME Systems
lina.gomez@acmesystems.com | +1 (617) 555-0147

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating a hands-on demo that works for Procurement + Security teams

Looping in Ben (manager) because procurement may need a formal contract timeline, and Ben has the authority to approve a compressed MSA review if ACME is on a tight window.

Karthik — can you confirm whether 07:30 PT start is doable for the SE run-through? If we start at 07:30 PT, that gives us 60 minutes: 07:30–08:15 (product + integration), 08:15–08:35 (security Q&A), 08:35–09:00 (procurement commercial). If that split looks tight, propose adjustments.

Marissa — if we do 07:30 PT, I can draft the calendar invite and include the questionnaire + MAP and flag the procurement block as optional/required per ACME’s ask.

Thanks, Priyom
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating a hands-on demo that works for Procurement + Security teams

07:30 PT is workable for me on weekdays next week (I will be online early). One ask: if Mark from security needs architecture diagrams and a short I/O pattern slide, can we pre-share that doc 24 hours prior? I’ll prepare a two-slide summary: high-level architecture + token/data retention flow.

If ACME can confirm 07:30 PT on either Nov 9 or Nov 10, I’ll block the time. Otherwise I can do Nov 12 as a fallback.

Ben — for MSA timeline, we typically provide a 5-business-day turnaround for standard redlines; if procurement needs an accelerated review we can escalate. Want me to include a short note in the MAP that flags an expedited review path?

— Karthik

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmesystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, ACME Procurement <procurement@acmesystems.com>, sec-requests@acmesystems.com
Date: 2026-11-03T09:22:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating a hands-on demo that works for Procurement + Security teams

Thanks all — Nov 9 at 07:30 PT (10:30 ET / 16:30 CET) works for Mark and our procurement lead (we’ll join as two people). We appreciate the split agenda.

Please send the slides and the security questionnaire in the invite. Procurement asks for an initial MSA timeline (your standard 5-business-day plus an optional expedited 48–72 hour window if we sign off to run that route). If you can include that in the MAP and the calendar description, we’ll confirm the invite.

See you then — Lina

Attachments to expect: redwood-security-questionnaire.xlsx

--
Lina Gomez | Director, Cloud Engineering, ACME Systems

[Calendar invite created]: Nov 9 07:30–08:30 PT — \"Technical demo + Security + Procurement\" — organizer: Marissa Cole. Invite includes: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf, redwood-security-questionnaire.xlsx, two-slide architecture summary (to be uploaded by Karthik). HubSpot deal updated: ACME-2026-Q4-RED-112.
